Sharpens the partial-derivation audit Part 2a (equal-split-only; 'swapped pair dominates' moves α the wrong way). α remains UNDERIVED; the derivation must live on the self-energy/geometric side (α=1), not pair-count. scope-(b) exclusion; no fit; nothing wired; L2 unchanged (2/7).
